title_as_printed: Table 3. Solubility of methane in aqueous calcium chloride at 25C and 30C, and in a solution both 1.53 N in NaCl and 6.0 N in CaCl2 at 30C
property_note: mole fraction of methane in the liquid; basis (salt counted as undissociated or as ions) not stated
pressure_note: psia as printed; total pressure of the cell; the paper's text calls it 'pressure of methane' when quoting Michels; water-vapour correction not stated in this table

T.constant: set per block by group_rows (25 or 30, from the '25C temp.' / '30C temp.' section headings)

skip_rows.reason: section labels ('25C temp.', '30C temp.') and salt-concentration block labels

conversion_needs: normality to molality needs solution density (not given); CaCl2 normality counts equivalents (1 N CaCl2 = 0.5 mol/L); mixed block: 1.53 N NaCl = 1.53 mol/L NaCl, 6.0 N CaCl2 = 3.0 mol/L CaCl2
notes: Table printed as two side-by-side column pairs in two temperature sections. Stacked per v2.1 rule 11: within each temperature section the left column blocks first, then the right. Order as written: 25C: 0.5 N, 1.0 N (left), 2.7 N, 5.0 N (right); 30C: 2.7 N, 9.5 N (left), 14.7 N*, mixed NaCl+CaCl2 (right). The section heading rows set nothing; every salt label row sets T and composition. The CaCl2-only blocks (29 rows) are already in GasBrineBench (DUFFY(1961)); the coordinator asked for the table complete as printed, so they are written here for reconciliation; only the last block (1.53 N NaCl + 6.0 N CaCl2, 30 C, 2 rows) is new. The 14.7 N block footnote * (saturated with CaCl2.6H2O) is stripped from the label and recorded in the note column as label:*.
